title: CSS Grid Changes EVERYTHING - Amazing Presentation
summary: Morten Rand-Hendriksen's WordCamp Europe 2017 talk presents CSS Grid Layout as a native two-dimensional layout system that changes how web pages are structured, including responsive layouts independent of source order. It was given as browsers began shipping support.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an inspiring demonstration of how powerful CSS Grid is and how it repairs the relationship between HTML and CSS.

quote.text: The speaker is good but I think I like it just because it fixes the relationship between HTML and CSS.
